answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Grafter grafted cutting mark witnessed at the nursery tally is the check, and it reads 4-year garden service, 92 supervised plantings, trowel exam, annual charter fees. One honest agent risks 104 POA once; a farm of 604 risks 62816 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. Trace the haven to its office, trace the harbor to its payer, and trace the vault to its year: the trail is the test. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
